synopsis: A group of high elves from the diaspora, traveling with Vereesa Windrunner and other Dalaran survivors, finally returns to Quel’Thalas to check on their people after the fall. Among them is Caelir Dawnspear, Falanaras’s brother, whose return turns what should be a reunion into a wrenching confrontation between shared blood and divided loyalties, while the visitors react with disgust and grief to the blood elves’ open reliance on fel crystals, mana-tapping, and carefully polished denial, turning estrangement into moral shock as well as political accusation.
title: Chapter 3: The Returning Exiles
